title: Tudor Gîrba - Moldable development
summary: Tudor Girba's Curry On! 2019 talk on moldable development, the idea that developers should build custom tools and views for each software system they work on. It draws on the Pharo and Glamorous Toolkit environments.
why: HN cites it as the clearest pitch for programmable, malleable development environments, especially in threads on Smalltalk, Emacs and user-programmable systems.

quote.text: To get a better idea of what I think is the better approach, check out these talks
